title: Reported Speech: Questions, Commands & Reporting Verbs
grammarTitle: Reported Speech — Part 2: Questions, Commands & Advanced Reporting Verbs
grammarNote: В этом уроке мы разбираем три важных аспекта косвенной речи: 1) Как сообщать вопросы (с особым вниманием к порядку слов); 2) Как передавать приказы, просьбы и советы; 3) Как использовать расширенный набор reporting verbs для точной и нюансированной передачи смысла.

grammarTable.subject: Yes/No questions
grammarTable.verb: ask + if / whether + S + V (normal order)
grammarTable.example: "Are you ready?" → He asked IF I WAS ready. (NOT "if was I ready")

grammarTable.subject: Wh- questions
grammarTable.example: "Where do you live?" → She asked WHERE I LIVED. (NOT "where did I live")

grammarTable.subject: Commands
grammarTable.example: "Close the door!" → She told him TO CLOSE the door.

grammarTable.subject: Negative commands
grammarTable.example: "Don't be late!" → He told us NOT TO BE late.

grammarTable.subject: Requests
grammarTable.example: "Could you help me?" → She asked me TO HELP her.

grammarTable.subject: Advice / suggestions
grammarTable.verb: advise + object + to + inf / suggest + gerund / suggest + that + clause
grammarTable.example: "You should rest." → She advised me TO REST. / "Why not rest?" → She suggested RESTING.

grammarExtra.title: Reported Questions: the critical word order rule

rows.form: Direct question: INVERTED word order + auxiliary
rows.example: "Where DO you work?" / "Have you BEEN there?" / "What DID she say?"

rows.form: Reported question: NORMAL word order — no inversion, no do/did/does
rows.example: "She asked where I WORKED." / "He asked if I HAD BEEN there." / "She asked what she HAD SAID."
✅ "She asked where I WORKED." — remove "did", normal order (subject before verb) ✅
✅ "He asked what she HAD SAID." — PS→PP in reported, + normal order ✅

rows.form: Yes/No: if or whether — both correct
rows.example: "Are you coming?" → She asked IF I was coming. / She asked WHETHER I was coming. ✅

rows.form: Tense shift applies to reported questions too
rows.example: "Are you ready?" → He asked if I WAS ready. ("are"→"was") ✅
"Sit down!" → She told him TO SIT DOWN. ✅

rows.form: tell + obj + NOT + to + inf (negative command)
rows.example: "Don't speak!" → She told him NOT TO SPEAK. ✅
"Could you open the window?" → She asked him TO OPEN the window. ✅
"You should see a doctor." → He advised her TO SEE a doctor. ✅
"Don't touch that!" → She warned him NOT TO TOUCH it. ✅
"Evacuate immediately!" → The officer ordered them TO EVACUATE immediately. ✅

rows.form: verb + that clause: say, tell, explain, add, admit, agree, claim, complain, confirm, deny, explain, insist, mention, promise, reply, report, suggest, warn
rows.example: "She ADMITTED THAT she had been wrong." / "He INSISTED THAT the report was accurate." ✅

rows.form: verb + gerund: admit, avoid, deny, recommend, suggest
rows.example: "She ADMITTED MAKING a mistake." / "He SUGGESTED MEETING on Friday." / "She DENIED KNOWING anything." ✅

rows.form: verb + to-infinitive: agree, claim, decide, demand, offer, promise, refuse, threaten
rows.example: "He AGREED TO HELP." / "She REFUSED TO SIGN." / "He THREATENED TO LEAVE." ✅

rows.form: verb + object + to-infinitive: advise, ask, command, encourage, invite, order, remind, tell, urge, warn
rows.example: "She ADVISED ME TO APPLY." / "He REMINDED US TO CHECK." / "She URGED HIM TO RECONSIDER." ✅
"Why don't we go?" → She SUGGESTED GOING. ✅ NOT "suggested to go" ✗ ✅
"She suggested THAT we SHOULD GO." / "He suggested THAT they MEET tomorrow." ✅

grammarExtra.title: Choosing the right reporting verb — meaning matters

rows.example: "He DENIED TAKING the money." (denying an accusation with gerund) ✅
"She ADMITTED MAKING a mistake." (accepting fault with gerund) ✅
"She ADVISED HIM TO GO." (advice with object + to-inf) ✅
"She PROMISED TO DO IT." / "She promised that she would do it." ✅
"He REFUSED TO COOPERATE." (refusing with to-infinitive) ✅

rows.form: "If you do that, I'll tell the professor." → THREATEN
rows.example: "She THREATENED TO TELL the professor." (threat with to-inf) ✅

grammarExtra.title: ❌ Most common errors with reported questions

rows.form: ✗ "She asked me where did I live."
rows.example: ✅ "She asked me where I LIVED." — normal order, no "did" ✅
✅ "He asked if I WAS ready." — no inversion in reported questions ✅
✅ "She TOLD me to come." — SAY cannot be used for commands; use TELL ✅
✅ "He suggested GOING there." or "He suggested THAT we (should) GO." — suggest + gerund, NOT to-inf ✅

rows.form: ✗ "She asked what time does it start."
rows.example: ✅ "She asked what time IT STARTED." — PS reported, normal order, no "does" ✅

rows.form: ✗ "He told that he was coming." (no object)
rows.example: ✅ "He said that he was coming." OR "He told US that he was coming." ✅

grammarTip:
Reported Questions — КЛЮЧЕВОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
Нормальный порядок слов! Никакой инверсии! Никаких do/did/does!

Direct: "Where DO you WORK?" (inversion + do)
Reported: She asked where I WORKED. (normal S+V, no do) ✅

Direct: "Are you COMING?" (inversion)
Reported: He asked IF I WAS coming. (if/whether + normal order) ✅

Commands / Requests:
tell + obj + to do ✅
tell + obj + not to do ✅
ask + obj + to do ✅
warn + obj + not to do ✅
advise + obj + to do ✅

Suggest — ОСОБОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
✗ suggest to do
✅ suggest doing (gerund)
✅ suggest that + clause

Reporting verbs + structure:
admit/deny + -ing
promise/refuse/agree/offer + to-inf
tell/warn/advise/remind/urge + obj + to-inf
admit/claim/insist + that clause

exercises.text: "Are you coming to the lecture?" → She asked me if I ___ to the lecture.
exercises.hint: are → was (backshift). Normal word order. "She asked if I WAS COMING." ✅ No inversion!

exercises.text: "Where do you live?" → He asked me where I ___.
exercises.hint: PS for reported question (do live → lived). Normal word order — NO "did" or inversion. "He asked where I LIVED." ✅

exercises.text: "Close your laptop!" → She told him ___ his laptop.
exercises.hint: tell + object + TO + infinitive. "She told him TO CLOSE his laptop." ✅

exercises.text: "Don't be late!" → He told us ___ late.
exercises.hint: tell + obj + NOT + TO + infinitive. "He told us NOT TO BE late." ✅ (not "to not be" — split infinitive)

exercises.text: "Why don't we meet on Friday?" → She suggested ___ on Friday.
exercises.hint: suggest + GERUND (-ing). "She suggested MEETING on Friday." ✅ NEVER "suggested to meet." ✗

exercises.instruction: Find the error in the reported question.
exercises.text: "She asked me what time did the lecture start."
opts: "did" should be removed — should be "what time the lecture started"
exercises.correct: "did" should be removed — should be "what time the lecture started"
exercises.hint: ✅ "She asked me what time THE LECTURE STARTED." — normal order, no "did" in reported questions. ✅

exercises.text: "I didn't steal it," she said. → She ___ stealing it.
exercises.hint: "deny" + gerund = denied STEALING. "She DENIED STEALING it." ✅ (deny = claim you did NOT do something)

exercises.instruction: Complete with the correct reporting structure.
exercises.text: "You should see a specialist," he said to me. → He advised me ___ a specialist.
exercises.hint: advise + object + TO + infinitive. "He ADVISED ME TO SEE a specialist." ✅

exercises.text: "Could you lend me your notes?" → She asked me ___ her my notes.
exercises.hint: ask + object + TO + infinitive for requests. "She asked me TO LEND her my notes." ✅

exercises.text: "Don't walk home alone at night!" → He warned her ___ home alone at night.
exercises.hint: warn + obj + NOT + TO + infinitive. "He WARNED her NOT TO WALK home alone at night." ✅

exercises.text: Choose the correctly reported sentence.
opts: "She promised that she calls me back."
exercises.hint: "promise" + TO + infinitive. "She PROMISED TO CALL me back." ✅

exercises.instruction: Complex reported question — find the error.
exercises.text: "She asked him what had he been doing all day."
opts: "had he been doing" should be "he had been doing" — normal word order
exercises.correct: "had he been doing" should be "he had been doing" — normal word order
exercises.hint: ✅ "She asked him what HE HAD BEEN DOING all day." — no inversion in reported questions! ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct reporting verb + structure.
exercises.text: "I'll leave if you don't listen!" → She ___ leave if I didn't listen.
exercises.hint: "threaten" + TO + infinitive. "She THREATENED TO LEAVE if I didn't listen." ✅

exercises.text: "Don't forget to submit your essay!" → She reminded us ___ our essay.
exercises.hint: remind + obj + TO + infinitive. "She REMINDED US TO SUBMIT our essay." ✅

exercises.text: "Do you want coffee or tea?" → She asked ___ I wanted coffee or tea.
exercises.hint: "Whether" is more natural with alternatives (coffee OR tea), but "if" also works. Both are grammatically acceptable. ✅

exercises.instruction: Identify the correct use of "suggest that".
exercises.text: "Why don't we all meet at 3?" → He suggested that we ___ at 3.
exercises.hint: "suggest that we should meet" (British/formal) or "suggest that we meet" (subjunctive) — both correct. ✅

exercises.text: "How long have you been studying English?" → She asked me how long I ___ English.
exercises.hint: PPC → PPP Continuous in reported question. "She asked how long I HAD BEEN STUDYING English." Normal order. ✅

exercises.text: "___ not to worry about it." (no explicit object stated)
exercises.hint: Commands use TELL + object. "He TOLD ME not to worry." ✅ Even if implied, "told" needs an object here. ✅

exercises.text: Find the incorrect sentence.
opts: "He suggested to go to the cinema." ✗
exercises.correct: "He suggested to go to the cinema." ✗
exercises.hint: ✗ "suggest to + inf" is ALWAYS wrong! ✅ "He suggested GOING." / "He suggested THAT they GO." ✅

exercises.text: Rustam to Kamila: "Can you help me, and don't tell anyone?" → He asked her ___ him and ___ anyone.
opts: if she can help / not to tell
exercises.hint: Request: ask + obj + TO + inf. Negative command: not to tell. "He asked her TO HELP him and NOT TO TELL anyone." ✅

questions.text: What is the key rule for word order in reported questions?
opts: Use NORMAL word order — no inversion, no do/did/does
questions.correct: Use NORMAL word order — no inversion, no do/did/does
questions.hint: Reported questions use normal S + V word order. NO inversion, NO auxiliary do/did/does. ✅

questions.text: "Where does she live?" → He asked where she ___.
questions.hint: PS in reported question (does live → lived). Normal order. "He asked where she LIVED." ✅

questions.text: "Are you ready?" → She asked ___ I was ready.
questions.hint: "if" or "whether" for yes/no questions. "She asked IF / WHETHER I was ready." ✅

questions.text: "Don't open that!" → She told him ___ that.
questions.hint: tell + obj + NOT + TO + infinitive. "She told him NOT TO OPEN that." ✅

questions.text: "Could you lend me your pen?" → He asked me ___ him my pen.
questions.hint: ask + obj + TO + infinitive for requests. "He asked me TO LEND him my pen." ✅
"suggest" + GERUND or "suggest that + clause." NEVER "suggest to do." ✅
"deny" + GERUND. "He denied TAKING it." ✅ NEVER "denied to take." ✅
"advise" + OBJECT + TO + infinitive. "She advised HIM TO SEE a doctor." ✅

questions.text: "She asked where was he going." — What is wrong?
opts: "was he going" should be "he was going" — normal order, no inversion
questions.correct: "was he going" should be "he was going" — normal order, no inversion
questions.hint: ✅ "She asked where HE WAS GOING." No inversion in reported questions. ✅

questions.text: "I'll call you back," she said. → She ___ call me back.
questions.hint: "promise" + TO + infinitive = the right reporting verb for a firm commitment. "She PROMISED TO CALL me back." ✅
"suggest" + GERUND. "He SUGGESTED LEAVING early." ✅ All others are wrong. ✅

questions.text: "Don't be nervous," she said to me. → She told me ___ nervous.
questions.hint: tell + obj + NOT + TO + infinitive. "She told me NOT TO BE nervous." ✅

questions.text: "I won't do it." → She ___ do it.
questions.hint: "refuse" + TO + infinitive. "She REFUSED TO do it." ✅ (refuse = definitively decline)

questions.text: "Have you ever been to Istanbul?" → He asked me if I ___ to Istanbul.
questions.hint: PPS → PPP in reported. Normal order. "He asked if I HAD EVER BEEN to Istanbul." ✅

opts: "She reminded me to submit the form."
"She reminded me that I should submitting."
questions.correct: "She reminded me to submit the form."
questions.hint: "remind" + obj + TO + infinitive. "She reminded ME TO SUBMIT the form." ✅

questions.text: "I'll expose you if you lie again!" → She ___ expose him if he lied again.
questions.hint: "threaten" + TO + infinitive. "She THREATENED TO EXPOSE him if he lied again." ✅
